name: Poison Cloud
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Your symbiotes exude a cloud of poisonous vapor that extends in all directions out to Short Range. The vapor is translucent, of a color that you choose, and its movement is controlled by you. Roll Fortitude to set the spell's Difficulty.

Any time a creature begins its turn within the cloud, it rolls Fortitude against the Difficulty. Failure, the creature takes 5d8 damage. On a pass, half damage. Breathing the vapor is not required for a creature to be affected.

At the start of each of your turns, you may move the cloud up to 10 ft in any direction. The cloud is susceptible to wind, per GM discretion.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: You may extend the cloud out to Medium range.
